s.d: having become fixed and definite in form
x: distinguish between crystallized and uncrystallized opinion

s.d: having both internal structure and external form of a crystal
x: quartz crystal is perfectly crystallized

s.d: having definitive and fixed form, solidified.
x: The assertion that true value is crystallized labour-time is on a par with the statement that opium puts people to sleep because it is soporific.

s.d: being crystalline, in the form of crystals.
to give something a definite or precise form.
fruit cooked in sugar syrup and encrusted with a sugar crystals
(uncountable) Synonym of candied fruit.
strips of gingerroot cooked in sugar syrup and coated with sugar
honey in which some of the glucose content has spontaneously crystallized from solution as the monohydrate.
the formation of crystals
any chemical element that belongs to the carbon group.
x: Carbon, the lightest carbon group element, sublimates at 3825 °C.

s.d: The nucleus of a newly-formed crystal.
Synonym of crystalloid.
(rare) Any member of the carbon group (group 14) of elements.
a specialist in crystallography
a person skilled in crystallography
